sloka: नदन्ति कावम् मुदिताः शकुना  सङ्घशः कलम् ।आह्वयन्त इव अन्योन्यम् काम उन्मादकरा मम ॥४-१-४६॥
transliteration: nadanti kāvam muditāḥ śakunā  saṅghaśaḥ kalam ।āhvayanta iva anyonyam kāma unmādakarā mama ॥4-1-46॥

translations.english: 'If spring reigns wherever my beloved Sita is, she must have been overwhelmed with similar sad feelings like me.
